Stem Cells & Regenerative Medicine: An Honest Overview

Stem cells and other regenerative products are the subject of ongoing research. The term “regenerative” does not establish that a product is effective, approved or appropriate for breast enhancement.

Home/Non-surgical/Regenerative medicine

Research versus established care

Many marketed regenerative uses remain unapproved or investigational. Products marketed as regenerative can carry risks including infection and other serious complications, and permitted uses vary by jurisdiction.
